query: SELECT secret_metadata.resource_id,secret_metadata.name,secret_metadata.data FROM secret_metadata JOIN resources ON resources.id = secret_metadata.resource_id WHERE resources.project_id = ? AND (secret_metadata.resource_id > ? OR (secret_metadata.resource_id = ? AND secret_metadata.name > ?)) ORDER BY secret_metadata.resource_id,secret_metadata.name LIMIT 101
